caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a small Whisper model over six epochs, comparing four different configurations: small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8. The x-axis represents the training epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 with a linear scale and tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis represents WER, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The orange dashed line with circular markers (small AdaLoRA_int4) starts at approximately 35.0 WER at epoch 0, rises to a peak of about 42.5 at epoch 2, and then decreases to around 32.5 at epoch 6. The solid orange line with circular markers (small AdaLoRA_int8) begins at 35.0 WER, gradually declines to approximately 31.0 by epoch 6. The dashed orange line with square markers (small int4) starts at 30.0 WER, increases to about 33.5 at epoch 2, then drops to roughly 25.0 by epoch 6. The solid orange line with square markers (small int8) begins at 30.0 WER and steadily decreases to approximately 25.0 by epoch 6.
